sources.title: Minutes of Guildford Borough Council, Full Council (full council), 5 March 2025 — item 20. Waste and Recycling Strategy — party in overall control of the council on the date: Liberal Democrats — councillors named in this passage: Councillor Julia McShane (Liberal Democrats)
sources.heading: Guildford Borough Council, Full Council, 5 March 2025 — 20. Waste and Recycling Strategy
sources.group: Councils controlled by the Liberal Democrats
sources.text:
Councillor Julia McShane introduced the waste and recycling strategy, including fortnightly bin collections.
RESOLVED that the strategy be adopted.

sources.title: Minutes of Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council, Full Council (full council), 26 February 2025 — item 10. Notice of Motion - Weekly Bin Collections — party in overall control of the council on the date: Labour — councillors named in this passage: Councillor Hannah Kitching (Liberal Democrats; not the party in control)
sources.item_title: Notice of Motion - Weekly Bin Collections
sources.heading: Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council, Full Council, 26 February 2025 — 10. Notice of Motion - Weekly Bin Collections
sources.text:
Councillor Kitching moved that weekly bin collections be restored.
[name removed] asked about recycling centres.
Upon being put to the vote the motion was lost.
named: Councillor Hannah Kitching (Liberal Democrats; not the party in control)

segments.text: At Barnsley, the minutes record a motion on how often bins are emptied, as when Councillor Kitching moved
At Guildford, the minutes record that Councillor Julia McShane introduced “the waste and recycling strategy, including fortnightly bin collections”
The minutes record the cabinet as saying “bins will be emptied every week”
Every council in the region did the same.
